fallback_history.trigger: new immutable history file creation blocked by connector safety/write guard
fallback_history.append_rule: Fetch current ledger and blob SHA; preserve exact prior bytes; append exactly one compact JSON object plus newline; entry must include previous_ledger_blob_sha equal to fetched SHA; update with that fresh SHA; re-fetch; verify old content is exact prefix; parse the appended suffix as exactly one JSONL record whose top-level RUN_ID equals the intended RUN_ID. Nested RUN_ID fields inside payload are allowed and must match; never use raw substring-count uniqueness.
fallback_history.completed_run_rule: A completed run may use ledger fallback only when the record contains the exact complete finalized payload and structural readback succeeds. latest/state/manifest may then advance and record history_mode=ledger_fallback and ledger_blob_sha.
fallback_history.partial_run_rule: If the complete finalized payload is unavailable, append only a truthful partial/failure receipt and do not advance latest/state/manifest.
